issue.title: Fix: Acessing Document _source using painless script is returning wrong result

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
When SearchHit.toXContent() populating the script field value, the DocumentField might hold a reference to SearchLookup whose actual state might already be modified since it was initialized because script.execute() could return the same SearchLookup reference for multiple document hits. This will lead to the same field value getting returned for multiple documents hits. The fix is simply storing the actual value map instead of reference to SearchLookup when constructing the DocumentField so that the original field value will always get fetched when populating the SearchHit.

This might not be very the best fix, happy to discuss more if anyone has better way to solve this. 

Closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/52103

body:
@tilan7663 Thank you for the report and detailed analysis. The underlying issue is SearchLookup uses a shared object across documents for source (and doc values). This object should not be held onto across documents, yet we may hold onto it if returning from a script field (note that this could happen in other contexts that return Object as well). Unfortunately I don't think the associated PR will completely fix the issue, as it would only catch the case of a root object being a source lookup, but the script could return eg a Map containing the source lookup as a value.

I'm not sure of a better solution right now, but we plan to discuss this in our scripting triage over the next week.
@rjernst Thanks for looking into it. I will close my PR.
